program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 6)) (objects g 0)))
         (template (first (sort objs (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (rel (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 template))
                                     (- (second p) (obj-c1 template))))
                   (obj-cells template))))
    (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
               ([marker (in-list (find-color g 2))]
                [p (in-list rel)])
      (let ((r (+ (first marker) (first p)))
            (c (+ (second marker) (second p))))
        (if (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out r c 6)
            out)))))
